JioBlackRock Flexi Cap Fund: A Systematic Approach to Investing
Investing can often be complex and daunting. The JioBlackRock Flexi Cap Fund gives you exposure across large-cap, mid-cap, and small-cap stocks, helping you tap into growth potential across market segments—all through a single fund. The fund aims to adopt a systematic approach to stock selection and portfolio construction, setting it apart from traditional and fundamental approaches.
